ontologyRestore.title: Import ontology
ontologyRestore.intro: Restore a supported Turtle / JSON-LD file into a new local ontology. Preview dependencies and conflicts before the atomic import. Resource IRIs are preserved; local revisions are assigned anew. Existing names or IRIs and unsupported semantics block import without overwriting content.

semanticView.title: View semantics
semanticView.pin: Fields come from frozen ontology v{revision}. Saving a template pins this version.
semanticView.noFields: This frozen version has no supported fields for this binding.
semanticView.utc: Dates mean midnight UTC. Timestamps must use ISO 8601 with Z or an explicit offset and are displayed in UTC.
semanticView.wgs84: Use numeric WGS84 decimal degrees: latitude −90 to 90 and longitude −180 to 180. Text and place names are not converted.
semanticView.positiveMeasure: Areas and radii use the selected positive numeric measure. Missing, nonnumeric, zero and negative values are excluded.
semanticView.hierarchyDirection: Only the selected relation is used. Organization, indent and impact trees follow child→parent; equity, control and clan trees follow upstream→downstream.
semanticView.missing: Semantic fields are not configured for this view. Expand View semantics to select them.
semanticView.invalidConfig: A selected field is unavailable in the frozen ontology or has an unsupported type. Select a valid field.
semanticView.unsupported: This layout does not consume these bindings. Choose the corresponding hierarchy, measure, time or map layout.
semanticView.legacy: This older template has no semantic bindings and retains its previous display. Configure fields and save a new template to make their meaning explicit.
semanticView.stale: The ontology version has changed. This template cannot be applied. Switch to a graph using the current ontology version and configure it again.
semanticView.noRelation: The visible graph has no edges for the selected relation, so a hierarchy cannot be drawn.
semanticView.invalidHierarchy: The selected relation contains cycles or multiple parents for a tree node. Choose another relation or a general graph layout.
semanticView.noData: No data meets the configuration requirements for this view.
semanticView.invalidMeasure: Excluded {count} entities whose selected measure is missing or not a valid positive number.
semanticView.invalidTime: Excluded {count} entities with missing or invalid dates, or timestamps without a time zone.
semanticView.invalidCoordinates: Excluded {count} entities with missing, nonnumeric or out-of-range WGS84 coordinates.
semanticView.instantOnly: Only one time property is configured. Gantt marks represent instants; end dates and durations are not inferred.
semanticView.loading: Loading semantic fields from the frozen ontology…

kb.title: Knowledge bases
kb.subtitle: Manage documents, processing tasks and traceable search evidence.
kb.name: Knowledge base name
kb.globalAccess: Shared globally · All signed-in users can read and search; administrators and editors can maintain content.
kb.archiveConfirm: Archiving excludes this base and its documents from search. Existing evidence remains accessible. You can restore it.
kb.restoreConfirm: Restore access to current indexes. Individually archived documents must be restored separately.
kb.documentArchiveConfirm: Exclude this document from search while retaining historical evidence. You can restore it.
kb.archivedNotice: This base is archived. Restore it to upload, search and maintain content. Historical evidence remains accessible.
kb.noMatch: No records match these filters. Try adjusting them.
kb.emptyBases: No knowledge bases yet. Create one to start uploading documents.
kb.uploadHint: UTF-8 {formats} only, up to {size} MiB per file; {documents} documents and {baseChunks} chunks per base, {chunks} chunks per document.
kb.fileTooLarge: File exceeds the 2 MiB limit. Reduce its size and try again.
kb.uploaded: Document received. Follow processing in the task history.
kb.duplicateUpload: Identical content already exists. Opened the existing document without creating a duplicate.
kb.emptyDocuments: No documents. Upload UTF-8 text, Markdown or CSV to build an index.
kb.indexTaskExplanation: The active index and latest task are separate. An older index may remain searchable after reprocessing fails; this does not mean the latest task succeeded.
kb.pollPaused: Automatic refresh paused. Tasks may still be running; refresh to check.
kb.semanticUnavailable: Embedding service is not configured. Semantic and hybrid search are unavailable; keyword search is available.
kb.answerUnavailable: Answer model is not configured. Evidence excerpt answers are unavailable; documents and keyword search remain available.
kb.scoreExplanation: Cosine similarity ranges from -1 to 1 and is not a probability. Keyword scores rank term matches; hybrid scores combine rankings and do not represent answer confidence.
kb.searching: Searching. Previous queries cannot overwrite newer results…
kb.searchSummary: {matches} matching chunks; showing the top {shown}. Searchable documents: {documents} / {total}.
kb.coverageWarning: Coverage limits: {failed} failed, {processing} processing, {partial} partially complete documents; {excluded} unavailable semantic chunks excluded.
kb.answerExplanation: Answers quote retrieved evidence verbatim. Open each citation to verify the source; these are evidence excerpts, not freely generated conclusions.
kb.insufficientEvidence: Insufficient evidence for a supported excerpt answer. Refine the question or add documents.
kb.noResults: No evidence matches this query and threshold. Adjust keywords, search mode or threshold.
kb.resultLimit: Each search returns up to 50 ranked chunks, shown in pages. Refine the query for more specific results.
kb.searchPrompt: Enter keywords to search. Open evidence to inspect source text, location and generation.
kb.archivedEvidence: This retained evidence belongs to an archived document or base and is excluded from current search.
kb.historicalEvidence: This evidence belongs to a historical generation. Its source location is retained; new graph references cannot be added.
kb.normalizedSource: Normalized source text (line endings and Unicode NFC). Highlighting matches the exact chunk character range. Markdown is shown as source text.
kb.manualExplanation: A user associates this document excerpt with an existing entity or direct fact in a pinned graph revision. This does not claim that the fact was extracted from the document or establish verified extraction provenance.
kb.linkReadonly: Administrators and editors can add manual references to current, unarchived evidence.
kb.refineEntity: Showing the first 30 entities. Refine the search to find a specific entity.
kb.directFactsOnly: Only existing outgoing direct facts are listed, with original predicates. No facts are created or inferred.
